scope: Four explicitly labelled temporary light comparisons of the same R03 complete-bay camera, then two existing close witness positions for guide/threshold. No source edits or new accepted lighting master.
queue_policy: Same production concurrency group, queue:max, cancel-in-progress:false; never cancels R03 or adds render concurrency.
acceptance: Actual returned pixels establish the cause. No automatic G3 pass, no source changes, and no G4 until visual gate.
